gen-gf-tektur-gf-alexandria: Pipe-cleaner strokes and oversized lowercase give Tektur its odd, expressive look, with every curve left gaping at the ends. Alexandria takes over as the sans-serif body, tall in the lowercase with short stems above and below.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-amiko: Amiko sets tall, thick-stroked lowercase with outward-pointing terminals, a modern sans that gives the Tektur heading something sturdy to stand beside. Tektur stays slim and uniform, so the weight sits below.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-gujarati: Approachable describes Anek Gujarati, whose lowercase rivals its capitals, while Tektur keeps hairlines out of its heading entirely. Paragraphs should flow smoothly, the wide c keeping each word open.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-latin: Tektur traces every glyph with a single, uniform line. It earns its keep large and brief, while Anek Latin, a sans-serif whose lowercase nearly reaches the capitals, handles the rest.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-tamil: Modern in spirit, Anek Tamil builds big round lowercase bowls with curves that look half unwrapped. And Tektur does the showy work with rounded-wire strokes, leaving Anek Tamil the quieter job of carrying text.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-anek-telugu: Clean and approachable, Anek Telugu lets wide, tall bowls drive its rhythm, rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. Tektur, drawn with one marker, earns its keep big and brief.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-m: Tektur keeps one unbroken line weight from terminals to junctions. It is made for loud display lines, while Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, a sans-serif, spreads open counters through the text.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-cossette-texte: Quirky wire strokes up top, then Cossette Texte arrives with wide-eyed lowercase e shapes and a prominent x-height. Tektur supplies the flair, and that flair meets a body with real presence.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-duru-sans: Duru Sans gives small letters wide openings and bodies that dominate the line. Against the spaghetti-like strokes of Tektur, this sans-serif body supplies the weight and the reading comfort the pair needs.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-fresca: Outsized lowercase makes Tektur instantly recognizable. Make the heading small and its quirks shrink away, while Fresca, a sans-serif with big bowls and short ascenders, stays open and connected.
